specs.short_description:
The Epson WorkForce AM-C550 A4 Color Multifunction Printer is a compact, energy-efficient MFP and photocopier designed to enhance productivity. With fast FPOT, high print speeds, and dependable performance, it delivers outstanding results for demanding workflows. Ideal for modern businesses, it seamlessly blends innovation and efficiency to manage all your printing and photocopying needs with ease.
A4 Multifunctional Printer

PrecisionCore Heat-Free Technology
User-Friendly 10.1″ Color Touchscreen

Product Data Sheet
specs.full_description:
Boost Office Printing with the Epson WF AM-C550
The Epson WF AM C550 Printer is designed for speed and efficiency. It offers an impressive print speed of 55 ISO ppm in both black and color. It also features scan speeds of 50 ipm (simplex) and 100 ipm (duplex). Designed for high productivity, it supports up to legal-sized media and delivers a fast first page out to keep your workflow moving. With a recommended monthly print volume ranging from 4,500 to 30,000 pages, this printer is ideal for demanding office environments. The AM-C550 offers the lowest power consumption in its class, using up to 65% less energy than color laser printers. It promotes energy efficiency without compromising performance. Its user-friendly 10.1″ color touchscreen interface is intuitive and customizable. It provides a seamless user experience similar to the Epson WorkForce AM Series A3 models, making it a perfect fit for any modern workplace.
To get details about printer consumables and ink related to this printer, check here –
Printer Consumables
.
Enhance Efficiency with the Compact Size
The Epson WorkForce AM-C550 A4 Color Multifunction Printer redefines compact printing with its innovative ‘C’ shaped paper path. This design offers a sleek look without compromising performance. With a maximum paper capacity of up to 2,100 pages and rapid First Page Out Time (FPOT), this printer ensures seamless, high-speed print and scan operations. Engineered for efficiency, the AM-C550 saves up to 70% on energy compared to conventional printers, making it an eco-friendly choice for modern workplaces. Its simplified paper path and advanced non-contact printing technology make it easy to handle diverse media types. Whether it’s daily office tasks or specialized printing needs, the AM-C550 delivers exceptional reliability and versatility.
For more technical details, related software, and drivers, check here –
Printer Support
.
Efficient and Professional Office Printing
The Epson WF AM C550 Printer offers exceptional versatility with its compact design. It can be configured as either a desktop or floor-standing unit, making it the perfect fit for any office space. Whether your environment is small or large, this printer adapts seamlessly to your needs. The AM-C550 is equipped with DURABrite® Pro fast-drying, water-resistant pigment ink. It delivers vibrant color and sharp black text, ensuring professional-quality prints every time. Additionally, it is built with a comprehensive suite of advanced security features to protect your sensitive data. This makes it ideal for business environments that prioritize confidentiality. For seamless workflow integration, the WF AM-C550 is compatible with the Epson Solutions Suite and leading third-party solutions via the Epson Open Platform. This allows businesses to streamline processes and improve efficiency across various applications, making it a reliable and adaptable choice for any modern office.

specs.short_description:
The Epson WorkForce Enterprise AM C4000 is a powerful inkjet printer and photocopier machine built for high-speed, eco-friendly business printing. With PrecisionCore Heat-Free technology, advanced cloud and mobile connectivity, and robust finishing options, this enterprise printing solution is perfect for businesses that demand speed, quality, and sustainability. Experience uninterrupted productivity and professional output with the Epson AM C4000 multifunction Epson Inkjet Printer.
Designed to meet the evolving needs of modern offices, the Epson AM C4000 offers a compact footprint without compromising on performance. Whether you’re handling large print volumes, scanning critical documents, or ensuring secure access across departments, this Workforce Enterprise AM C4000 printer delivers reliability and precision at every step.
40 ISO ppm print speed with Heat-Free PrecisionCore technology
High-resolution output at 600 x 2400 dpi
Large 5,150-sheet paper capacity for uninterrupted printing
Dual-head, single-pass duplex scanning up to 120 IPM
Secure enterprise printing with Epson Print Admin
Professional finishing options, including stapling and booklet making
Product Data Sheet
specs.full_description:
High performance, Low intervention
Epson Workforce WF AM C4000​ Printer – Enhance your business productivity with WorkForce Enterprise. Eliminate frequent time-consuming disruptions caused by consumable changes, supply mismanagement, troubleshooting, or waiting for IT support. Instead, focus on seamless and on-demand printing for your business.
Built For Business
The PrecisionCore technology, which is also utilized in Epson’s commercial and industrial devices, offers a dependable and powerful printing solution that businesses can trust. Additionally, optional embedded cost recovery and follow-me print solutions provide advantages such as cost monitoring and waste reduction.
Key Feature : WF AM - C4000 Printer
Breakthrough printing speed
– 40 ISO ppm
+
(mono/colour) –  the fastest print speed in its class
Quality and reliability without compromise
– The utilization of advanced Heat-Free PrecisionCore technology along with a stationary line head enables the production of high-speed and top-notch professional output.
Create a significant effect while reducing expenses
– This network Multi-function Device delivers cost-effective, high-quality output at a resolution of 600 x 2400 dpi.
Conserve Energy
– With Epson Heat-Free Technology, a printer consumes only one-fourth of the energy used by a laser printer.
Manage your printer fleet and keep costs in check
– The Epson Device Admin software can be employed and is also able to work in conjunction with external software solutions for managing user authentication, usage restrictions, and other related functions.
Print from anywhere
– The inclusion of Epson Connect provides a comprehensive range of mobile printing functions.
Achieve greater productivity with a user-friendly interface
– The 10.1″ touchscreen allows users to conveniently send files to email or the cloud.
Optional professional finisher
– This solution is ideal for a variety of tasks such as stacking, stapling, creating booklets, hole-punching, and more.
Expedite your workflow
– Maximum paper capacity of 5,150 pages (1,150 standard) for high-volume printing
Work Smarter
– A dual-head, single-pass scanner can scan two-sided documents concurrently at up to 120 IPM..
Powerful & Professional Printer
Discover a remarkable combination of speed and quality with our cutting-edge printing technology. Epson Workforce WF AM C4000​ Printer offers an impressive image resolution of 600 x 2400 dpi, ensuring consistently superb results. What sets us apart is our lightning-fast printing speeds, capable of producing up to 40 pages per minute in both simplex and duplex modes. When it comes to efficiency, our printer takes the lead. With incredibly fast first page out times, it outpaces color lasers and copiers by one and a half times for the initial page and two and a half times for typical business print jobs. Moreover, it achieves all this while utilizing just a fraction of the energy consumed by traditional laser printers, making it an environmentally conscious choice.In addition to its exceptional speed and eco-friendliness, our printer boasts an impressive paper capacity of 5,150 sheets. With such a high capacity, you can complete extensive print jobs without the need for constant paper replenishment. Whether you’re printing 50,000 black pages or 30,000 color pages, our printer delivers consistent results without interruptions.
Precision Core Inkjet Technology
Epson’s revolutionary technology, called PrecisionCore, incorporates a line head heat-free printing method that ensures rapid printing while maintaining exceptional print quality. This innovative system incorporates Epson’s advanced thin-film piezoelectric (TFP) elements, which are produced using the MEMS manufacturing process, based on semiconductor micro-fabrication techniques. At the heart of this proprietary technology lies the PrecisionCore MicroTFP print chip, a digital chip that operates without relying on heat to eject ink. This chip enables printing at the micron level, which is 1/100th the size of a human hair. The remarkable focus on precision and detail allows PrecisionCore to deliver groundbreaking results. Furthermore, the absence of heat leads to reduced power consumption, fewer consumables, and less intervention, resulting in time and cost savings.
Fast Print Speeds
The utilization of Heat-Free PrecisionCore technology guarantees the delivery of each nozzle on the print head. This leads to incredibly fast print speeds that surpass those of color lasers. WorkForce Enterprise printers provide high-quality, double-sided color prints at exceptionally fast print speeds, allowing for increased productivity without compromising on quality. Any project can be effortlessly handled with speed and efficiency.
Simple Wireless Connectivity (Optional)
You can effortlessly connect to your wireless network with the support of 802.11n. Wi-Fi Direct makes it simple for users to connect to wireless networks without the need for a router, enabling convenient printing from any room in the office within seconds.
For a comprehensive overview of the technical specifications of this printer, refer to the enclosed
product datasheet
. You can also explore the
Product Support
link provided for additional information.
Productivity Anytime, Anywhere
You can conveniently print from your tablet or smartphone by utilizing Epson Connect™. It supports various devices such as Android™, Apple® iPad and iPhone, Chromebook™, Kindle Fire™, Mac®, and Windows® devices. Whether you are in the office or on the move, you can wirelessly print documents, photos, emails, and web pages. Additionally, you have the option to scan documents and store them in the cloud for effortless access and collaboration.
Confidentiality and Security
Epson offers Epson Print Admin (EPA), a solution for cost recovery and scan workflow that enhances security and streamlines processes. EPA provides several benefits, including easy access, confidentiality, and control, which significantly improve workflow efficiency. This solution is particularly valuable in environments that prioritize confidentiality and require quick and direct access to prints. Examples include senior management, legal and HR departments, as well as customer-facing roles such as teachers, doctors, nurses, and retail staff who cannot leave customers, patients, or students unattended to retrieve prints
Professional Finishing Options
Epson Workforce WF AM C4000​ Printer is designed to work seamlessly with optional finishers to facilitate professional document production. These finishers include a staple finisher that can handle tasks such as shifting, stacking, and hole punching.Furthermore, a Booklet finisher allows for folding and saddle stitching output, adding a professional touch to documents.
By incorporating these finishers, the time required to create large volumes of materials and proposals is significantly reduced, enhancing overall work efficiency.
Scan to and print from the cloud
You can conveniently print from your smartphone or tablet while on the go by utilizing Google Cloud Print™ with your Gmail™ or Google Drive™ account. Additionally, you can print directly from your Chromebook™ and Google Chrome™ without the need to install drivers or connect any cables. This makes it even simpler to share your documents and images from any location.
Product Frequently Asking Question
How does the PrecisionCore Technology benefit this AM C4000 businesses printer?
PrecisionCore technology guarantees reliable and top-notch printing while also offering optional features for cost recovery and follow-me print solutions to monitor expenses and minimize waste.
How does the Epson WorkForce Enterprise AM C4000 Printer conserve energy?
It conserves energy through Epson Heat-Free Technology, consuming only one-fourth of the energy used by a laser printer.
What are the connectivity options for printing with the Epson WF AM C4000 Printer?
You can wirelessly print from a variety of devices, such as tablets and smartphones, using Epson Connect™. Additionally, you can connect to wireless networks via 802.11n or Wi-Fi Direct for easy and convenient printing.
What is the printing speed of this WF AM C4000 printer?
The Epson WorkForce AM C4000 Printer can print at speeds of up to 40 pages per minute (PPM) for both color and monochrome.
Is the Epson WF AM C4000 Printer suitable for large workgroups?
The Epson WF AM C4000 Printer is suitable for large workgroups due to its high-capacity features, robust performance, and efficient workflow capabilities.

– A dual-head, single-pass scanner can scan two-sided documents concurrently at up to 120 IPM..
Powerful & Professional Printer
Discover a remarkable combination of speed and quality with our cutting-edge printing technology. Epson Workforce WF AM C4000​ Printer offers an impressive image resolution of 600 x 2400 dpi, ensuring consistently superb results. What sets us apart is our lightning-fast printing speeds, capable of producing up to 40 pages per minute in both simplex and duplex modes. When it comes to efficiency, our printer takes the lead. With incredibly fast first page out times, it outpaces color lasers and copiers by one and a half times for the initial page and two and a half times for typical business print jobs. Moreover, it achieves all this while utilizing just a fraction of the energy consumed by traditional laser printers, making it an environmentally conscious choice.In addition to its exceptional speed and eco-friendliness, our printer boasts an impressive paper capacity of 5,150 sheets. With such a high capacity, you can complete extensive print jobs without the need for constant paper replenishment. Whether you’re printing 50,000 black pages or 30,000 color pages, our printer delivers consistent results without interruptions.
Precision Core Inkjet Technology
Epson’s revolutionary technology, called PrecisionCore, incorporates a line head heat-free printing method that ensures rapid printing while maintaining exceptional print quality. This innovative system incorporates Epson’s advanced thin-film piezoelectric (TFP) elements, which are produced using the MEMS manufacturing process, based on semiconductor micro-fabrication techniques. At the heart of this proprietary technology lies the PrecisionCore MicroTFP print chip, a digital chip that operates without relying on heat to eject ink. This chip enables printing at the micron level, which is 1/100th the size of a human hair. The remarkable focus on precision and detail allows PrecisionCore to deliver groundbreaking results. Furthermore, the absence of heat leads to reduced power consumption, fewer consumables, and less intervention, resulting in time and cost savings.
Fast Print Speeds
The utilization of Heat-Free PrecisionCore technology guarantees the delivery of each nozzle on the print head. This leads to incredibly fast print speeds that surpass those of color lasers. WorkForce Enterprise printers provide high-quality, double-sided color prints at exceptionally fast print speeds, allowing for increased productivity without compromising on quality. Any project can be effortlessly handled with speed and efficiency.
Simple Wireless Connectivity (Optional)
You can effortlessly connect to your wireless network with the support of 802.11n. Wi-Fi Direct makes it simple for users to connect to wireless networks without the need for a router, enabling convenient printing from any room in the office within seconds.
For a comprehensive overview of the technical specifications of this printer, refer to the enclosed
product datasheet
. You can also explore the
Product Support
link provided for additional information.
Productivity Anytime, Anywhere
You can conveniently print from your tablet or smartphone by utilizing Epson Connect™. It supports various devices such as Android™, Apple® iPad and iPhone, Chromebook™, Kindle Fire™, Mac®, and Windows® devices. Whether you are in the office or on the move, you can wirelessly print documents, photos, emails, and web pages. Additionally, you have the option to scan documents and store them in the cloud for effortless access and collaboration.
Confidentiality and Security
Epson offers Epson Print Admin (EPA), a solution for cost recovery and scan workflow that enhances security and streamlines processes. EPA provides several benefits, including easy access, confidentiality, and control, which significantly improve workflow efficiency. This solution is particularly valuable in environments that prioritize confidentiality and require quick and direct access to prints. Examples include senior management, legal and HR departments, as well as customer-facing roles such as teachers, doctors, nurses, and retail staff who cannot leave customers, patients, or students unattended to retrieve prints
Professional Finishing Options
Epson Workforce WF AM C4000​ Printer is designed to work seamlessly with optional finishers to facilitate professional document production. These finishers include a staple finisher that can handle tasks such as shifting, stacking, and hole punching.Furthermore, a Booklet finisher allows for folding and saddle stitching output, adding a professional touch to documents.
By incorporating these finishers, the time required to create large volumes of materials and proposals is significantly reduced, enhancing overall work efficiency.
Scan to and print from the cloud
You can conveniently print from your smartphone or tablet while on the go by utilizing Google Cloud Print™ with your Gmail™ or Google Drive™ account. Additionally, you can print directly from your Chromebook™ and Google Chrome™ without the need to install drivers or connect any cables. This makes it even simpler to share your documents and images from any location.
Product Frequently Asking Question
How does the PrecisionCore Technology benefit this AM C4000 businesses printer?
PrecisionCore technology guarantees reliable and top-notch printing while also offering optional features for cost recovery and follow-me print solutions to monitor expenses and minimize waste.
How does the Epson WorkForce Enterprise AM C4000 Printer conserve energy?
It conserves energy through Epson Heat-Free Technology, consuming only one-fourth of the energy used by a laser printer.
What are the connectivity options for printing with the Epson WF AM C4000 Printer?
You can wirelessly print from a variety of devices, such as tablets and smartphones, using Epson Connect™. Additionally, you can connect to wireless networks via 802.11n or Wi-Fi Direct for easy and convenient printing.
What is the printing speed of this WF AM C4000 printer?
The Epson WorkForce AM C4000 Printer can print at speeds of up to 40 pages per minute (PPM) for both color and monochrome.
Is the Epson WF AM C4000 Printer suitable for large workgroups?
The Epson WF AM C4000 Printer is suitable for large workgroups due to its high-capacity features, robust performance, and efficient workflow capabilities.

specs.short_description:
The Citizen CZ 01 printer is a lightweight, space-saving professional photo printer that introduces a new segment within Citizen’s product lineup. Engineered for both amateur photographers and professionals, this dye sublimation photo printer delivers stunning prints at an affordable cost. Thanks to its ultra-compact footprint and low weight, it’s easy to handle and transport, making it an ideal photo booth printer or a mobile solution for events.
Lightweight & compact design (only 5.8 kg) for easy transport
High-quality output for both amateur and professional use
Anti-curl system delivers smooth, flat photo prints
Supports 4×6″ & 4.5×8″ media, up to 150 prints per roll
Eco-friendly with 28% less power consumption
Efficient cooling for reliable high-volume printing
Works with Windows, Mac & SDK for easy integration
Product Data Sheet
specs.full_description:
Discover the Features of Citizen CZ01 Printer
User-Friendly Photo Printer
The Citizen CZ01 photo printer is user-friendly, making it simple to operate and navigate for users of all levels of skill. Its simple interface and detailed instructions make printing simple and hassle-free, and its small size and light weight make it portable and simple to set up
Improved Printer Driver
The Citizen CZ-01 photo printer has a new printer driver that gives you more flexibility and control over the printing process. More personalization choices are available with the new driver, including adjustments to brightness, contrast, and color balance. Users can precisely customize their prints using this feature, producing output of higher quality.
Key Features of CZ01 Printer
Photo printer that is compact and lightweight, weighing only 5.8 kg
For perfectly flat prints, a new anti-curl feature
New cooling technology for volume printing applications
Available media sizes are 4.5 x 8″ and 4 x 6″.
4 x 6″ media has 150 prints per roll.
Environmentally friendly with a 28% reduction in power consumption
There are available Windows, Mac, and SDK (Software Development Kit) drivers for direct integration with business software solutions.
Compact and Lightweight
The Citizen CZ-01 photo printer is created to be lightweight and compact, making it extremely portable and easy to use. It is a fantastic option for photographers who need to print photos on the go or in confined spaces without sacrificing quality or performance due to its small size and lightweight.
Multiple Print Modes
Two distinct print modes—high-quality mode and high-speed mode—are available for users to select when using the Citizen CZ-01 photo printer. While the high-speed mode enables faster printing without significantly compromising quality, the high-quality mode produces prints with exceptional image detail and sharpness. Users now have the freedom to select the print mode that best suits their requirements.
Quick Paper Loading
The Citizen CZ01 photo printer has a quick and simple paper loading system with a drop-in paper loading feature and comfortable ribbon handling. As it makes it possible to fast & easily switch between media types and easily load paper into the printer, this feature can be helpful for business and professional use. The printer supports multiple genuine media options, including Citizen CZ-MS458 and Citizen
CZ-MS456
, enabling users to switch efficiently between different print formats.

Product Frequently Asking Questions
Is the Citizen CZ01 suitable for professional use?
Yes, the CZ01 is specifically designed for professional use. Its precise color control, high-resolution output, and exceptional print quality make it an excellent choice for professional photographers, digital photo studios, photo party booths, event planners and professionals who require top-notch prints for their clients.
What are the available media sizes and print quantities for the Citizen CZ01 photo printer?
The available media sizes are 4.5 x 8″ and 4 x 6″. The 4 x 6″ media comes with 150 prints per roll, making it convenient for volume printing applications.
What is the advantage of the quick paper loading feature in the Citizen CZ01 professional photo printer?
The quick paper loading feature, accompanied by the convenient drop-in paper loading and easy ribbon handling, enables effortless transition between different media types and rapid paper loading. This attribute proves especially advantageous for business and professional applications.
Is the CZ01 Printer is suitable for the photo booth printing?
Citizen CZ01 is a perfect photo printer for photo booths, professional photo studios, and kiosks. Its portability and high photo printing speed make it an ideal choice for such applications. It also offers multiple finishing options and has a printing resolution of 300 and 600 dpi

specs.full_description:
The Epson SC F100 is a high-performance A4 dye sublimation printer equipped with Epson’s PrecisionCore™ Micro TFP Printhead, delivering sharp, high-resolution prints with consistent color accuracy. Powered by Epson Precision Dot Technology, this sublimation printer ensures vibrant image output with excellent tonal range and density. It supports multiple print modes to balance quality and speed, making it ideal for a variety of applications including mug printing, T-shirt printing, art reproductions, and promotional items. Its versatility also extends to signage, custom merchandise, and textile products, providing professional results even in compact workspaces.
Using a reliable 4-color UltraChrome Dye Sub ink system, the Epson SC F100 Printer offers outstanding print durability and color performance. This dye sublimation printer is engineered to reduce operational costs while ensuring long-term reliability. The resulting prints offer excellent resistance to light, washing, abrasion, and perspiration perfect for custom apparel and soft goods. When used on polyester fabrics, the output also meets the Oeko-Tex Eco Passport® standards, making it safe for T-shirt printing and other applications involving products for children and babies.
Best A4 Dye Sublimation Printer
High Quality
:
Epson uses a PrecisionCore print head and UltraChrome Dye Sub ink for high-quality imaging with resolutions up to 600 x 1200 dpi. Epson Precision Dot Technology allows for prints that exhibit smooth gradations, a wider range of colors, and minimal grain.
Simple to Operate
:
The control panel tilts and adjusts, featuring a color LCD screen and push-button functionality. It comes with a driver that allows seamless operation with popular graphic and photo editing software.
Easy to Install:
This device is highly compact and can be mounted on a desktop. It comes with over 1 liter of ink and 300 pages of media. You can operate it flexibly using Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or USB networking.
High Productivity:
The device includes a tank system and a tray with a capacity of 150 sheets, capable of printing an A4 page in just 65 seconds.
Low Running Costs:
It has extremely low power usage, and users can replenish it with economical bottled ink.
Superior Reliability:
The product includes a manufacturer’s warranty, extendable up to 3 years, with optional Cover Plus for additional protection.
Adaptable Workflow
Epson Sublimation Printer
aims to replace traditional screen printing, providing a simpler, more cost-effective solution for short-to-medium production runs. It requires less labor, uses fewer materials, and
generates less waste
. The use of digital imaging makes content creation and editing simpler, leading to output that is more accurate and adaptable. The streamlined and productive production process enables quicker job completion and effortless replication at the touch of a button. This method is suitable for fabrics with a high polyester content and hard surface materials. Moreover, it applies to materials that can withstand moderate levels of heat and pressure using a polyester spray. Create diverse products such as fabric and photo items, metal signs, mugs (mug printing), phone covers, custom clothing (
T-shirt Printing
), wall décor, and home accessories.
Epson Sublimation Ink
Eco-Friendly Fabric Printing
Epson designed the DS Fabric series specifically to ensure reliable and cost-effective performance. The Epson SC F100 model comes with a Continuous Ink Supply System (CISS) that users can easily refill using affordable 140-ml bottles (
Black
,
Cyan
,
Magenta
,
and
Yellow
). The engine has very low power usage and can also go into sleep or standby modes which helps to decrease operating expenses even more. Additionally, the printer is shipped with both ink and media included. It also comes with a driver that enables seamless integration with commonly used graphic software.
The Epson SC F100 printer is compatible with both Windows and Mac OS when connected to a PC. It is remarkably small and lightweight, occupying less than 0.15 m2 of space. The printer supports both wired and wireless networking options. It is designed to work seamlessly with a compact flat sheet or merchandise-style heat press. The printer includes a user-friendly multi-page input tray and an extendable output tray.
For a comprehensive overview of the technical specifics of this printer, refer to the provided
product datasheet
. You can also access additional support materials via the
Product Support
link.
Product Frequently Asking Questions
Is the Epson SureColor F100 a sublimation printer?
Yes, the Epson SureColor SC-F100 is a professional-grade A4 dye sublimation printer designed specifically for high-quality sublimation printing. Compact in size, it is ideal for small businesses and startups creating personalized items like mugs, T-shirts, phone cases, and promotional merchandise. The Epson SC F100 uses dye sublimation ink and transfer paper to produce vibrant, durable prints on polyester fabrics and coated surfaces with excellent color accuracy and detail.
What is the printing resolution of the SC F100?
The printer offers a 600 x 1,200 dpi (dots per inch) printing resolution, ensuring sharp and detailed prints.
Does the printer come with sublimation ink and paper?
The printer package includes a set of starter sublimation ink cartridges. However, sublimation paper is typically purchased separately.
Can I use the Epson SC-F100 for commercial production?
Yes, the Epson SC-F100 is well-suited for commercial production, especially for small to medium-sized businesses. It is ideal for applications like T-shirt printing, mug printing, and personalized gifts printing. With its compact A4 size, dye sublimation technology, and reliable print quality, it enables efficient short-run production while maintaining vibrant, professional-grade output across a range of products.
Does the SC-F100 printer support wireless printing?
Yes, the SureColor F100 typically offers wireless connectivity options, allowing you to send print jobs to the printer without the need for direct physical connections.

specs.full_description:
The Epson SureColor SC-F500 is a high-performance 24-inch dye sublimation printer engineered for small businesses and creative production studios that demand professional quality, fast turnaround, and low running costs. Powered by Epson’s PrecisionCore™ TFP print head and an advanced 4-color UltraChrome Dye Sub ink system, the SC-F500 produces vivid, color-accurate output across a wide range of sublimation products — from custom apparel and soft goods to promotional items and hard-surface merchandise. Whether you run a print-on-demand business, a personalized gifts shop, or a T-shirt printing operation in the UAE, the SC-F500 is built to keep pace with your production demands.
Printing at 2,400 x 1,200 DPI with 800 nozzles per color channel, this wide-format sublimation printer achieves smooth gradients, sharp detail, and consistent tonal density across every job. The CMYK ink system ensures that colors transfer with exceptional fidelity onto polyester fabrics and coated hard substrates, giving your finished products a professional, retail-ready appearance.
Refillable Ink — Even While Printing
One of the SC-F500’s most practical advantages is its continuous refillable ink solution. The 140ml ink bottles are designed for easy, tool-free refilling — and uniquely, you can replenish the ink tanks mid-job without interrupting your print run. This dramatically reduces downtime and keeps your production line moving, especially during high-demand periods. With an ink tank capacity of 110ml per color, the SC-F500 is built for sustained, high-volume sublimation printing with minimal operational interruption.
Wi-Fi Connectivity — A First for Epson’s Dye Sublimation Range
The SC-F500 introduces wireless printing to Epson’s dye sublimation lineup for the first time. With IEEE 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi, USB 3.0, and Gigabit Ethernet all available as standard, integrating this printer into your existing workflow is straightforward — whether you’re working from a design studio, a retail print shop, or a production floor. Wireless connectivity means your design team can send jobs directly from their workstations without being physically tethered to the machine.
Simple Operation — No Specialist Knowledge Required
Epson designed the SC-F500 so that any team member can operate it confidently, regardless of their technical background. The 4.3-inch color touchscreen provides intuitive access to all printer settings and status information, and it can even be operated while wearing gloves — a practical detail for busy production environments. The automatic media changeover function lets operators switch between cut sheets and roll media without manual reconfiguration, keeping jobs moving smoothly from one format to the next.
Anti-Dust Design for Consistent Print Quality
Nozzle clogging is one of the most common causes of misfires and downtime in sublimation printing. The SC-F500 features a built-in anti-dust design that actively protects the print head from dust contamination, reducing the frequency of cleaning cycles and virtually eliminating misprints caused by blocked nozzles. This means more uptime, less wasted media, and a lower overall cost per print.
Built-In Accounting Tool for Cost Control
Managing your print costs is just as important as managing your print quality. The SC-F500 includes an easy-to-use accounting software tool that calculates precise ink usage and cost-per-print data, giving business owners and production managers clear visibility into their consumable expenses. This makes it significantly easier to price custom jobs accurately and protect your profit margins.
The Complete End-to-End Epson Solution
The Epson SC-F500 is part of Epson’s comprehensive end-to-end dye sublimation ecosystem — covering inks, DS Transfer General Purpose sublimation paper (available in A4, A3, and multiple roll widths), and RIP software, all engineered to work together seamlessly. Using genuine Epson T49N-series sublimation inks (Black, Cyan, Magenta, and Yellow, each in 140ml bottles) ensures optimal color output, head longevity, and consistent results across every print. A maintenance box and auto-cutter spare blade are also available to keep the machine in peak condition over the long term.
Applications — What Can You Print with Epson SC-F500?
The SC-F500 supports an exceptionally broad range of sublimation applications, making it one of the most versatile wide-format sublimation printers available for small and medium-sized businesses:
Apparel & Soft Goods:
T-shirts, polo shirts, hoodies, sportswear, custom uniforms, tote bags, and polyester-blend fabrics.
Promotional & Corporate Items:
Mouse mats, desk pads, lanyards, and branded soft goods.
Home & Lifestyle Products:
Cushion covers, pillowcases, wall art panels, and fabric décor.
Photo & Gift Products:
Photo mugs, ceramic tiles, phone covers, and framed fabric prints.
Signage & Displays:
Fabric banners, pop-up displays, and roll-up exhibition graphics.
This range of applications makes the SC-F500 an ideal investment for promotional printing businesses, photo labs, e-commerce merchandise brands, and custom gifting operations across the UAE and the wider GCC region.
Compact Design, Professional Output
Despite its 24-inch print width, the SC-F500 has been designed with workspace efficiency in mind. At 970 x 811 x 245mm and weighing 29kg, it fits comfortably into most small business and studio environments without dominating the floor plan. The understated, professional aesthetic means it suits both production floors and customer-facing retail settings equally well.
The printer is compatible with Windows 7, 8, 8.1, and 10, as well as macOS 10.11 and later, and operates on a standard AC 100–240V supply — making it suitable for use across the UAE and internationally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is the Epson SureColor SC-F500 a sublimation printer?
Yes, the Epson SureColor SC-F500 is a professional-grade 24-inch dye sublimation printer. It uses Epson’s PrecisionCore™ TFP print head and T49N-series dye sublimation inks to produce vibrant, durable prints on polyester fabrics and coated hard-surface substrates such as mugs, phone covers, and mouse mats.
What is the print resolution of the SC-F500?
The SC-F500 prints at up to 2,400 x 1,200 DPI, delivering sharp detail and smooth color gradients across a wide range of sublimation media.
Can the SC-F500 print on roll media?
Yes. The SC-F500 supports both cut sheet media (A4 and A3) and roll media up to 24 inches (610mm) wide, with an auto-switching function that makes changing between formats quick and easy.
What inks does the Epson SC-F500 use?
The SC-F500 uses Epson’s T49N-series dye sublimation inks — Black (C13T49N100), Cyan (C13T49N200), Magenta (C13T49N300), and Yellow (C13T49N400) — each available in 140ml refill bottles.
Can I refill the ink while the printer is running?
Yes. One of the SC-F500’s key advantages is that its refillable ink tanks can be topped up mid-print without pausing the job, significantly reducing production downtime.
Is the SC-F500 suitable for a small business in the UAE?
Absolutely. The SC-F500 is specifically designed for small to medium-sized businesses — including promotional print shops, photo labs, custom merchandise producers, and T-shirt printing businesses — offering a low total cost of ownership, ease of use, and high-quality output without requiring specialist technical knowledge.
Does the SC-F500 support wireless printing?
Yes. The SC-F500 was the first dye sublimation printer in Epson’s range to offer Wi-Fi connectivity (IEEE 802.11b/g/n), alongside USB 3.0 and Gigabit Ethernet.
